qa_pair.question: Inspect the Video importer capability and Web codec-matrix contract. Which recommended video codec and container are reported for Web, in that order?
Inspect the strict Web/Desktop Video override schema. Which five selectable encoder backends are available besides auto? Answer as a comma-separated list in reported order.
Inspect the Web Video codec matrix. Which two video codecs are represented by WebM entries? Answer as a comma-separated list in reported order.
Inspect Video platform override validation. What inclusive even-integer range is accepted for maximum width and height?
Inspect the persistent Video Player creation contract. Which five output target modes are supported? Answer as a comma-separated list in reported order.
Inspect the persistent Video Player clock contract. Which three update modes are supported? Answer as a comma-separated list in reported order.
Inspect a newly normalized persistent Video Player. Is muted enabled by default for browser-safe autoplay? Respond True or False.
Inspect the Cinematic Video clip contract. Must its timeScale be strictly positive because reverse browser-video playback is unsupported? Respond True or False.
Inspect apply_video_importer. Must confirm be the literal value true before publishing an imported artifact? Respond True or False.
Inspect all ten dedicated Video MCP schemas. Are unknown input fields rejected before editor contact? Respond True or False.
